environment.description: Same container image deployed on EKS 1.29 with Pod Security Admission (PSA) enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. The pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volume mounts are defined in the pod manifest. The container's /tmp resolves to the read-only overlay filesystem layer. Additionally, a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy is applied that allows egress only to port 443 on CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 with explicit deny to 169.254.0.0/16 and 10.0.0.0/8 link-local/VPC ranges. Note: the PSA restricted profile does NOT itself enforce network restrictions - it only validates pod security fields. The Cilium policy entity selectors use CIDR-based L3 rules without DNS-aware resolution.
